build_inverse_sqrt_lr_scheduler: build a fairseq learning rate scheduler that decays LR by inverse square root of update number
create_inverse_sqrt_config: create an InverseSquareRootLRScheduleConfig dataclass with warmup_updates and warmup_init_lr parameters
run_step_update_lr: run step_update on InverseSquareRootSchedule to compute and set the learning rate for a given update number
review_warmup_phase_logic: review the InverseSquareRootSchedule warmup phase that linearly increases LR from warmup_init_lr to target LR
test_decay_factor_calculation: test the InverseSquareRootSchedule decay_factor calculation which equals warmup_end_lr times square root of warmup_updates
